subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Revises single letter sounds; distinguishes beginning and end sounds

show.line: The last sounds! q, q, queen. z, z, zip. x is at the end. Fox. Box.

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with q, as in queen?
Which one starts with z, as in zip?
Fox. What is the last sound? Say it.
Which one ends with x, as in fox?
Say the sound with me. z, as in zip!
Tap the letter that says q.
rounds.praise: Yes! q has a tail that flicks out.

rounds.prompt: Starts with q, starts with z, or ends with x? Sort the pictures.

hints: q always has u with it. Queen, quilt.
x is a sound at the end. Fox, box, six.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will say the last sound in box.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Box ends with x. Bo, x.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say it slowly. Boxxx. The last sound is x!

parent_line: Can hear and recognise the sounds q, z and x.
